_comment: Shared cases for the keyword retrievers, which have two implementations: chainforge/rag/retrievers.py (reference) and chainforge/react-server/src/backend/browserRetrievers.ts. Both test suites read this file so a divergence fails a build. Expected values were generated from the Python implementation. Similarities are rounded to 10 decimal places to absorb float formatting differences only. Keep a query containing a term present in more than half the corpus (currently 'is'), or BM25's negative-idf epsilon floor stops being exercised.
